creative_premise: A browser-native climate with no protagonist, score, account, lore, dashboard, research framing, or product funnel. Visitor movement changes wind; visitor stillness changes pressure; nothing is retained.

implementation.determinism: Fixed simulation seed and deterministic mote initialization; ambient audio noise is ephemeral and begins only after a user gesture.
implementation.privacy: No persistence, analytics, accounts, network requests, or private source material.
performance: Canvas device pixel ratio capped at 2
Reduced particle count under reduced-motion preference
implementation.audio: Web Audio context is created only inside the explicit sound-button click handler; no autoplay.
